description: Maki's and Kilo CLI's Homebrew formulae, the Devin CLI and Warp Agent CLI casks, and Codewhale's formula from before its rename, installed and not run.
why: Nothing else on this machine names any of these agents, so each Homebrew token is its only witness. windsurf is forbidden because its cask is devin-desktop, and the devin-cli token must not be read as it; opencode because Kilo's CLI forks it. Codewhale is here through `deepseek-tui`, the formula its tap kept from before the rename; the current formula is 19's, so the old token is its only witness on this machine. deepseek-harness is forbidden because the token's name is DeepSeek's.
